note: 时间尺英文校准自写句(2026-10-20):补项目台词里少见的写法——数字 / 年份 / 时刻 / 小数、首字母词、Dr. 等缩写、多音节长词、一字一顿的碎句、逗号串、破折号、省略号、全大写喊叫、短句。说话人借 alices / jidi 已冻结声线的人物,覆盖人物卡语速 97.5–190 wpm。

lines.speaker: CHAR-cheshire-cat
lines.text: We're all mad here. I'm mad. You're mad.

lines.speaker: CHAR-cheshire-cat
lines.text: Extraordinary, isn't it? Absolutely, unmistakably, irrevocably extraordinary.

lines.speaker: CHAR-king-of-hearts
lines.text: Consider your verdict, gentlemen of the jury — carefully, deliberately, and without hurry.

lines.speaker: CHAR-king-of-hearts
lines.text: The trial begins at 9:30 on March 14th, 1865, in Courtroom No. 3.

lines.speaker: CHAR-king-of-hearts
lines.text: Silence!

lines.speaker: CHAR-caterpillar
lines.text: Who. Are. You?

lines.speaker: CHAR-caterpillar
lines.text: Keep your temper, child... and remember: one side makes you grow taller, the other side makes you grow shorter.

lines.speaker: CHAR-hatter
lines.text: Why is a raven like a writing-desk? I haven't the slightest idea!

lines.speaker: CHAR-hatter
lines.text: It's always six o'clock now — always tea-time, and we've no time to wash the things between whiles.

lines.speaker: CHAR-queen-of-hearts
lines.text: Off with her head! Off with his head! OFF WITH THEIR HEADS!

lines.speaker: CHAR-queen-of-hearts
lines.text: Can you play croquet? Then fetch the flamingos, the hedgehogs, and the soldiers, immediately.

lines.speaker: CHAR-gryphon
lines.text: The FBI, the CIA, and NASA all sent letters, but nobody read them.

lines.speaker: CHAR-gryphon
lines.text: What fun! It's all her fancy, that is. They never execute anybody, you know.

lines.speaker: CHAR-white-rabbit
lines.text: I'm late, I'm late, for a very important date! No time to say hello, goodbye!

lines.speaker: CHAR-white-rabbit
lines.text: Mary Ann! Fetch me a pair of gloves and a fan — quick, now!

lines.speaker: CHAR-mock-turtle
lines.text: Once, I was a real turtle. We went to school in the sea, every single day, for 25 years.

lines.speaker: CHAR-mock-turtle
lines.text: Reeling and writhing, of course, to begin with; and then the different branches of arithmetic.

lines.speaker: CHAR-alice
lines.text: Curiouser and curiouser! Now I'm opening out like the largest telescope that ever was!

lines.speaker: CHAR-alice
lines.text: I can't explain myself, I'm afraid, sir, because I'm not myself, you see.

lines.speaker: CHAR-alice
lines.text: Yes, please.

lines.speaker: CHAR-jie-rui-er
lines.text: Gate 47 closes at 11:15. After that, it's a 3.5-hour wait for the next shuttle.

lines.speaker: CHAR-jie-rui-er
lines.text: Dr. Seldon's office is on Level 12, past the Imperial Library. You can't miss it.
